models.name: Llama 3.1 8B (QLoRA)
models.notes: Winner. Fine-tuned on 5K SHAP-grounded SIU rationales; highest faithfulness and lowest cost at scale. PHI stays in-VPC (no third-party egress).

models.name: Qwen 2.5 7B
models.notes: Close second, slightly faster and cheaper, but weaker at selecting the highest-magnitude SHAP drivers without fine-tuning.

models.name: GPT-4o-mini
models.notes: Strong zero-shot faithfulness and lowest p50 latency, but ~4x cost per 1K decisions and routes PHI to a third party — a compliance non-starter for production SIU use.

rubric_scale: 1–5 per axis (factual grounding, signal selection, calibration, actionability)
